name: Bearer Token Authentication
description: Custom JWT-based Bearer authentication with email/password. No third-party auth provider. Provides middleware for protecting routes with role-based access control (user/staff/admin).

envVars.name: JWT_SECRET
envVars.description: Secret key for signing JWT tokens (min 32 chars)

envVars.name: JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRY
envVars.description: Refresh token expiry in seconds (default 604800 = 7 days)

dbTables.name: users
dbTables.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT, role TEXT DEFAULT 'user', active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, last_login TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_email ON users(email)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_role ON users(role)

dbTables.name: refresh_tokens
dbTables.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS refresh_tokens (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id))
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tokens_user ON refresh_tokens(user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tokens_hash ON refresh_tokens(token_hash)

routes.description: Login with email/password, returns access + refresh tokens
Exchange refresh token for new access token

cronJobs.description: Nightly cleanup of expired refresh tokens
